description: [Company & tax] Get an official, citable euro exchange rate for an invoice, ledger entry or tax return. Use when the rate must come from an official source rather than a market feed. Price: $0.004 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/ecb-fx

amount.description: Amount in base currency to convert (default 1)

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default latest); weekends/holidays use the previous ECB business day

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: ecb_fx_rates
title: ECB Euro FX Reference Rates and Conversion ($0.004)
